inductive Status where
  | pending : Status
  | confirmed : Status

structure Order where
  id : Nat
  status : Status

structure Input where
  orders : List Order

structure Output where
  orders : List Order

def Spec : Contract Input Output where
  pre  := fun _ => True
  post := fun i o =>
    (∀ ord_out ∈ o.orders, ord_out.status = Status.confirmed) ∧
    List.Perm (i.orders.map (fun ord => ord.id)) (o.orders.map (fun ord => ord.id))

example : Spec.pre ⟨[]⟩ ∧ Spec.post ⟨[]⟩ ⟨[]⟩ := by
  constructor
  · simp [Spec]
  · simp [Spec]

Requirement 1.4/S3 (Introduction > Project Scope):
Expandable with unique codes, the owners can purchase to expand the inventory.
results.lean_predicate:
structure Input where
  inventory : List Nat
  new_codes : List Nat

structure Output where
  updated_inventory : List Nat
  success : Bool

def Spec : Contract Input Output where
  pre  := fun i => i.inventory.Pairwise (λ x y => x ≠ y) ∧ i.new_codes.Pairwise (λ x y => x ≠ y)
  post := fun i o =>
    (o.success = true ↔ (∀ x ∈ i.new_codes, x ∉ i.inventory)) ∧
    (o.success = true → o.updated_inventory.Perm (i.inventory ++ i.new_codes)) ∧
    (o.success = false → o.updated_inventory = i.inventory)

example : Spec.pre ⟨[1, 2], [3, 4]⟩ ∧ Spec.post ⟨[1, 2], [3, 4]⟩ ⟨[1, 2, 3, 4], true⟩ := by
  simp [Spec]
